headings: A deeper, more intense interpretation of the Elegantly Tokyo fragrance featuring notes of cherry blossom, jasmine, bamboo wood, and akigalawood for a serene and sophisticated floral scent.

jsonld_raw.name: ELEGANTLY TOKYO ELIXIR PARFUM 100ML
jsonld_raw.description:
ELEGANTLY TOKYO ELIXIR PARFUM 100ML. A deeper interpretation of Elegantly Tokyo. Cherry blossom and jasmine offer delicate and sophisticated floral luminosity, while bamboo wood introduces a fresh, serene, and natural facet. Akigalawood completes the composition with a modern, structured woody dimension, adding character, depth, and a more intense sillage without losing the clean and subtle elegance that defines the fragrance.

A collection created by Ms. Jo Malone CBE, founder of Jo Loves.

Floral | Serene, sophisticated, and intense
